# People Team Hiring Process

A new position requires an approved headcount request containing the department, hiring manager,
job level, employment location, and budget code. The People team opens the role only after the
department manager and Finance approve the request.

Interview panels must use the approved scorecard and submit independent feedback before the
debrief. Candidate compensation must stay within the approved level band; exceptions require the
People Manager and Finance Manager.

Interview notes, compensation discussions, and background-check information are confidential and
must remain in the applicant tracking system. Hiring managers may receive the final status but
must not receive protected background-check details.
